title: Immigration and Child Mortality During the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 大规模移民时代的移民与儿童死亡率
title_primary: 大规模移民时代的移民与儿童死亡率
title_secondary: Immigration and Child Mortality During the Age of Mass Migration
authors: Katherine Eriksson, Peter Z. Lin, Gregory T. Niemesh
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In the late nineteenth century, Americans feared that crowded immigrant neighborhoods were spreading disease through industrial cities. We study this claim using newly constructed town-level panel data from Massachusetts, 1860 to 1915, a setting uniquely suited to this exercise because its early vital registration system allows consistent measurement of mortality before national registration became widespread. Using a shift-share instrumental variable strategy based on historical settlement patterns, we estimate the effect of local exposure to immigration on mortality. The relevant question is not whether immigrant families themselves experienced higher mortality, but whether immigration altered the local disease environment more broadly. We find that increases in the foreign-born share significantly raised infant and child mortality, with the infant effect falling disproportionately on the post-neonatal period. Mechanical changes in the composition of births by parent nativity account for only a portion of the estimated effect, implying that the results are not driven primarily by higher mortality among immigrant births. Instead, the evidence is consistent with increased exposure to immigrants, communicable disease, and spillovers to children of native-born parents. These findings highlight immigration as one factor shaping the mortality transition in crowded high-mortality environments.
abstract_zh: 在19世纪末，美国人担心拥挤的移民社区正在通过工业城市传播疾病。我们利用新构建的马萨诸塞州1860年至1915年城镇层面面板数据来研究这一说法，该背景特别适合此项研究，因为其早期生命登记系统使得在全国性登记普及之前能够一致地测量死亡率。我们采用基于历史定居模式的份额移动工具变量策略，估计当地移民暴露对死亡率的影响。相关问题不在于移民家庭本身是否经历了更高的死亡率，而在于移民是否更广泛地改变了当地的疾病环境。我们发现，外国出生人口比例的增加显著提高了婴儿和儿童死亡率，其中婴儿效应不成比例地落在新生儿后期。出生构成因父母出生地而发生的机械性变化仅解释了估计效应的一部分，这意味着结果并非主要由移民出生婴儿的更高死亡率所驱动。相反，证据与移民、传染病暴露增加以及对本土出生父母子女的溢出效应相一致。这些发现凸显了移民是塑造拥挤高死亡率环境中死亡率转变的一个因素。

title: Social choice rules when individuals are responsible for their skills
title_zh: 当个体对其技能负责时的社会选择规则
title_primary: 当个体对其技能负责时的社会选择规则
title_secondary: Social choice rules when individuals are responsible for their skills
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies social choice rules over sets of feasible utility vectors à la Nash’s (1950) bargaining problem. First, we identify necessary and sufficient conditions for choice rules to be rationalized by welfare orderings or functions over 0–1 normalized utility vectors. These general results are useful for providing an axiomatic foundation for a novel class of choice rules with normalization. Furthermore, we show that at the axiomatic level, this class of choice rules is closely related to the classical bargaining solution introduced by Kalai and Smorodinsky (1975).
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类社会选择规则，其对象为可行效用向量集合，遵循纳什（1950）讨价还价问题的框架。首先，我们识别了选择规则能够被0-1标准化效用向量上的福利排序或函数合理化的必要且充分条件。这些一般性结果有助于为带有标准化处理的新型选择规则类别提供公理化基础。此外，我们表明，在公理层面，这类选择规则与卡拉伊和斯莫罗丁斯基（1975）提出的经典讨价还价解密切相关。

title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
title_zh: 半人马基准：评估大语言模型在增强与自动化现实工作任务中的能力
title_primary: 半人马基准：评估大语言模型在增强与自动化现实工作任务中的能力
title_secondary: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
authors: Pattaraphon Kenny Wongchamcharoen, Kris Gulati, Min Min Fong, Abhishek Nagaraj
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.
abstract_zh: 大多数LLM基准测试根据模型自动化工作任务的能力对其进行排名。然而，在实践中，模型常被用来辅助其他（人类或LLM）代理。因此，驱动模型选择的问题不仅在于哪个模型能产出最佳结果，还在于哪个模型最能提升另一个（较弱的）代理的工作表现。我们引入了一个统一框架，用于评估模型自动化及增强另一代理表现的能力。在七个基于经济学的现实任务中，一个辅助模型为标准化低能力工人模型撰写辅助文本，后者负责产出最终成果。在自动化模式下，辅助模型直接生成输出。输出通过具有任务特定评分标准的LLM评审团进行盲法配对比较，并在十次运行中重复验证。两种模式下的排名仅呈适度相关性，自动化胜出者在七个任务中有五个在增强模式下失利。辅助并非总是正面的。在三个任务中，未受辅助的工人模型排名高于所有受辅助条件，且仅有一个模型的指导在平均情况下优于无指导。这些结果表明，自动化能力仅是辅助质量的非完全代理，这促使基准测试应根据模型在人类-AI及多代理系统中所扮演的角色来评估它们。

title: Ethnofederalism: Subnational Borders and the Salience of Ethnicity in Politics
title_zh: 民族联邦制：次国家边界与政治中民族性的凸显
title_primary: 民族联邦制：次国家边界与政治中民族性的凸显
title_secondary: Ethnofederalism: Subnational Borders and the Salience of Ethnicity in Politics
authors: Richard Bluhm, Roland Hodler, Paul Schaudt
official: 官方在线 2024-11-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how the design of subnational political borders shapes the salience of ethnicity in politics. We introduce a framework for measuring how political borders align with a country's ethnic geography at the micro level. We then leverage quasi-experimental variation in the alignment introduced by Kenya's 2010 constitutional reform, which divided the country's eight provinces into 47 counties. Our results suggest that ethnofederal reforms, i.e., reforms that increase the alignment between political borders and ethnic geography, would reduce ethnic voting in national elections. Finally, we evaluate alternative border designs and derive the design that would minimize ethnic voting.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了地方政治边界的设计如何影响政治中族群性的显著性。我们提出了一种框架，用于在微观层面衡量政治边界与国家族群地理的契合度。随后，我们利用肯尼亚2010年宪法改革引入的准实验性变化，该改革将全国八个省划分为47个县。我们的研究结果表明，民族联邦制改革，即增强政治边界与族群地理契合度的改革，会减少全国选举中的族群投票现象。最后，我们评估了替代性的边界设计方案，并推导出能最小化族群投票的最优设计。

title: Digraph placement games
title_zh: 有向图放置博弈
title_primary: 有向图放置博弈
title_secondary: Digraph placement games
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper considers a natural ruleset for playing a partisan combinatorial game on a directed graph, which we call Digraph placement. Given a digraph G with a not necessarily proper 2-coloring of V(G), the Digraph placement game played on G by the players Left and Right, who play alternately, is defined as follows. On her turn, Left chooses a blue vertex which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. On his turn Right chooses a red vertex, which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. A player loses if on their turn they cannot move. We show constructively that Digraph placement is a universal partisan ruleset; for all partisan combinatorial games X there exists a Digraph placement game, G, such that $$G = X$$ . Digraph placement and many other games including Nim, Poset Games, Col, Node Kayles, Domineering, and Arc Kayles are instances of a class of placement games that we call conflict placement games. We prove that X is a conflict placement game if and only if it has the same literal form as a Digraph placement game. A corollary of this is that deciding the winner of a Digraph placement game is PSPACE-hard. Next, for a game value X we prove bounds on the order of a smallest Digraph placement game G such that $$G = X$$ .
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种在有向图上进行党派组合博弈的自然规则集，我们称之为有向图放置（Digraph placement）。给定一个有向图G，其顶点集V(G)具有一个不一定正常的2-着色，由玩家Left和Right交替进行的Digraph放置博弈定义如下：轮到Left时，她选择一个蓝色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除；轮到Right时，他选择一个红色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除。若某玩家在其回合无法行动，则该玩家输掉游戏。我们构造性地证明，Digraph放置是一个通用的党派规则集；对于所有党派组合博弈X，存在一个Digraph放置博弈G，使得$$G = X$$。Digraph放置以及包括Nim、偏序集博弈、Col、Node Kayles、Domineering和Arc Kayles在内的许多其他博弈，都是我们称为冲突放置博弈的一类放置博弈的实例。我们证明，X是冲突放置博弈当且仅当它与某个Digraph放置博弈具有相同的字面形式。由此推论，判定Digraph放置博弈的胜者问题是PSPACE-hard的。接下来，对于博弈值X，我们证明了使得$$G = X$$的最小Digraph放置博弈G的阶数的界。

title: The Scars of Supply Shocks
title_zh: 供给冲击的伤痕
title_primary: 供给冲击的伤痕
title_secondary: The Scars of Supply Shocks
official: 官方在线 2020-11-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the effects of supply disruptions - for instance due to energy price shocks or the emergence of a pandemic - in an economy with Keynesian unemployment and endogenous productivity growth. By temporarily disrupting investment, negative supply shocks generate permanent output losses - or scarring effects. By inducing a negative wealth effect, scarring effects depress aggregate demand, which may even fall below the exogenous fall in supply. However, that scarring effects depress aggregate demand does not necessarily translate into low rates of inflation. On the contrary, scarring effects may reinforce and prolong the inflationary impact of supply disruptions. A contractionary monetary policy response may end up deepening scarring effects and increasing inflation in the medium run. A successful disinflation may require a policy mix of monetary tightening and fiscal interventions aiming at supporting business investment and the economy’s productive capacity.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在凯恩斯式失业与内生生产率增长的经济体中，供应中断（例如能源价格冲击或疫情爆发）所产生的影响。通过暂时扰乱投资，负向供应冲击会导致持久产出损失，即疤痕效应。疤痕效应通过引发负财富效应，抑制总需求，其下降幅度甚至可能超过外生供应减少。然而，疤痕效应抑制总需求并不必然转化为低通胀率。相反，疤痕效应可能加剧并延长供应中断的通胀影响。紧缩性货币政策回应最终可能加深疤痕效应，并在中期推高通胀。成功的通胀回落可能需要结合货币紧缩与旨在支持企业投资及经济生产能力的财政干预措施的政策组合。

title: Trade Fragmentation, Inflationary Pressures and Monetary Policy
title_zh: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力与货币政策
title_primary: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力与货币政策
title_secondary: Trade Fragmentation, Inflationary Pressures and Monetary Policy
authors: Maria Ludovica Ambrosino, Jenny Chan, Silvana Tenreyro, Tobias Adrian, Marcin Kolasa 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we develop a two-sector, small open-economy model featuring imperfect international risk-sharing and household heterogeneity, capturing both the supply-side and demand side effects of fragmentation. In the model, fragmentation takes the form of import-price increases or a decline in tradable-sector productivity. The sign and magnitude of its impact on inflationary pressures, and the appropriate policy response, depend not only on the direct effect of higher import prices or lower productivity on supply but also, crucially, on how aggregate demand adjusts to lower real incomes. In turn, this depends on the pace of fragmentation (gradual versus front-loaded) and other key structural factors highlighted by the model. We compare outcomes under Taylor-type monetary policy rules to a constrained-efficient allocation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全国际风险分担与家庭异质性的两部门小型开放经济体模型，以捕捉碎片化对供给侧和需求侧的双重影响。在该模型中，碎片化表现为进口价格上涨或可贸易部门生产率下降。其对通胀压力的影响方向与幅度，以及相应的政策应对，不仅取决于进口价格上涨或生产率下降对供给的直接效应，还关键地取决于总需求如何适应实际收入的下降。而这又取决于碎片化的速度（渐进式与前置式）以及模型所强调的其他关键结构性因素。我们将泰勒型货币政策规则下的结果与受约束的有效配置进行比较。

title: Why do eligible individuals fail to enrol for social assistance programmes? A systematic narrative review of factors affecting take-up
title_zh: 为什么符合条件的个人未参加社会救助项目？关于影响领取率的因素的系统性叙述综述
title_primary: 为什么符合条件的个人未参加社会救助项目？关于影响领取率的因素的系统性叙述综述
title_secondary: Why do eligible individuals fail to enrol for social assistance programmes? A systematic narrative review of factors affecting take-up
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do so many eligible individuals fail to sign up for government social assistance benefits? While non-take-up of social benefits is of great concern both for the effectiveness and equity of social policies, academics and policymakers continue to be puzzled by the lack of clarity on why people forgo increases in disposable income. Focusing on literature from the Global South, this review puts forward an analytical framework that identifies how structural conditions shape the context in which individual and institutional factors operate. Together, these interact to mitigate or exacerbate compliance, learning, and psychological costs as well as perceived relative benefits. Findings are synthesised around the three cost types. Overall, this review concludes that individual characteristics alone rarely explain non-take-up as their effects are moderated by the structural, programmatic and institutional conditions in which they operate. This helps explain why the literature often produces inconclusive or even contradictory findings regarding the determinants of take-up. These findings prompt further investigation into the structural conditions and programmatic and institutional factors that shape take-up gaps, and that policies aiming to close these gaps should consider.
abstract_zh: 为什么如此多符合资格的个体未能申请政府社会救助福利？尽管社会救助福利的不领取现象对于社会政策的有效性和公平性都极为重要，但学者和政策制定者对于人们为何放弃可支配收入增加的原因仍感到困惑。本综述聚焦于全球南方的相关文献，提出了一个分析框架，用以识别结构性条件如何塑造个体和制度因素运作的背景。这些因素相互作用，共同缓解或加剧了合规成本、学习成本、心理成本以及感知的相对收益。研究结果围绕这三种成本类型进行综合。总体而言，本综述得出结论，个体特征单独很少能解释不领取现象，因为其影响受到其所处的结构性、方案性和制度性条件的调节。这有助于解释为何文献中关于领取决定因素的研究结果往往不具结论性，甚至相互矛盾。这些发现促使进一步研究塑造领取差距的结构性条件及方案性和制度性因素，并提示旨在缩小这些差距的政策应考虑这些因素。

abstract: The 2008 financial crisis sparked a massive wave of scholarship reviewing the history of capitalism. To these ambitious narratives of economic history has now been added Trevor Jackson's The Insatiable Machine. Distinguishing itself in a crowded field, Jackson's incisive book covers the history of capitalism's global dominance in just over 300 pages, in which he seeks to explain ‘where capitalism came from, how it spread around the world, and how it came to be the dominant way of organizing human lives’ (p. 2).
abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机引发了一波大规模学术研究，重新审视资本主义历史。在这些宏大的经济史叙事中，如今又添上了特雷弗·杰克逊的《永不满足的机器》。在众多著作中脱颖而出，杰克逊这本见解深刻的书仅用300余页篇幅，涵盖了资本主义全球主导地位的历史，旨在解释“资本主义源自何处，如何传播至世界各地，以及如何成为组织人类生活的主导方式”（第2页）。

title: Can Productivity Growth Explain NAIRU? Long-run Evidence from Britain, 1871-1999
title_zh: 生产率增长能否解释NAIRU？来自英国1871-1999年的长期证据
title_primary: 生产率增长能否解释NAIRU？来自英国1871-1999年的长期证据
title_secondary: Can Productivity Growth Explain NAIRU? Long-run Evidence from Britain, 1871-1999
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The ?new economy? of the 1990s saw improving Phillips curve trade-offs coupled with faster productivity growth, particularly in the United States. This has led to a revival of the idea that there is an inverse relationship between productivity growth and the Non-Accelerating Inflation Rate of Unemployment (NAIRU). Because productivity trends evolve slowly, such effects have been difficult to identify using short runs of data. This paper investigates this relationship over a much longer period than usual. It draws on recently developed, historically-consistent, time series for the UK from 1871 to 1999. A two-equation model of unemployment and wage setting, that incorporates productivity effects, is estimated over the whole period allowing for shifts across major periods associated with changes in labour market institutions. The results indicate that trends in labour productivity do matter, but they go only part of the way towards explaining wide swings in average unemployment across the decades. Thus productivity is not the whole story, but it is some of the story. In addition, institutional changes appear to have enhanced the effects of productivity on the NAIRU, particularly in the post-Second World War era.
abstract_zh: 20世纪90年代的“新经济”时期，美国等经济体在菲利普斯曲线权衡关系改善的同时，出现了生产率加速增长的现象。这重新引发了关于生产率增长与非加速通货膨胀失业率（NAIRU）存在反向关系的讨论。由于生产率趋势演变缓慢，利用短期数据难以识别此类效应。本文基于比常规研究更长的历史跨度考察这一关系，采用近期构建的1871-1999年英国历史一致性时间序列数据。通过建立包含生产率效应的失业与工资决定双方程模型，在考虑劳动力市场制度变迁导致的不同时期结构性转变后，对全样本进行估计。结果表明：劳动生产率趋势确实具有解释力，但仅能部分解释数十年来平均失业率的剧烈波动。生产率虽非全部原因，却是重要影响因素。此外，制度变迁似乎强化了生产率对NAIRU的影响效应，尤其在二战后的时期表现更为显著。

title: Estimation and Inference for Multi-Threshold Regression with Endogeneity
title_zh: 内生性多阈值回归的估计与推断
title_primary: 内生性多阈值回归的估计与推断
title_secondary: Estimation and Inference for Multi-Threshold Regression with Endogeneity
authors: Chuang Wan, Hengzhao Hong, Wei Zhong, Changliang Zou, Runze Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Heterogeneity and endogeneity become increasingly common in statistical modeling and econometric practice. Threshold regression provides a simple yet flexible modeling strategy to account for heterogeneity. This paper studies estimation and inference for multi-threshold regression with endogenous regressors. We exploit a novel two-stage estimation procedure based on instrumental variables, which first identifies a set of possible threshold locations using the group LASSO estimation, and then refines the candidate set by a predetermined selection criterion. Given that the performance of the conventional information criteria is sensitive to the choice of the penalization factor, we develop a data-adaptive threshold-based cross-validation criterion incorporating an order-preserved sample-splitting strategy to determine the number of thresholds. Regarding inference, we develop test statistics to test for the presence of threshold effects and the existence of endogeneity, respectively. Numerical simulations and an application analyzing the threshold effects of 401(k) plans on wealth demonstrate the excellent finite sample performance of our methods. Finally, we develop a user-friendly R package MultiThreshold to implement the methodologies.
abstract_zh: 异质性和内生性在统计建模与计量经济学实践中日益普遍。阈值回归提供了一种简单而灵活的建模策略来处理异质性。本文研究了具有内生回归变量的多阈值回归的估计与推断问题。我们利用一种基于工具变量的新颖两阶段估计程序，该程序首先通过组LASSO估计识别一组可能的阈值位置，然后通过预定的选择准则对候选集进行精炼。鉴于传统信息准则的性能对惩罚因子的选择较为敏感，我们开发了一种数据自适应的基于阈值的交叉验证准则，结合保序样本分割策略来确定阈值数量。在推断方面，我们分别构建了检验统计量，用于检验阈值效应的存在性以及内生性的存在性。数值模拟和一项分析401(k)计划对财富阈值效应的应用展示了我们方法在有限样本下的优异表现。最后，我们开发了一个用户友好的R包MultiThreshold来实现这些方法。

title: The Value of School Social Climate Information: Evidence from Chicago Housing Transactions
title_zh: 学校社会氛围信息的价值：来自芝加哥住房交易的证据
title_primary: 学校社会氛围信息的价值：来自芝加哥住房交易的证据
title_secondary: The Value of School Social Climate Information: Evidence from Chicago Housing Transactions
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: I study how publicly released school social climate information is capitalized into housing markets and affects household sorting. Using the initial release of school climate ratings in Chicago as a plausibly exogenous information shock, I combine a border discontinuity design with event-study and difference-in-differences analyses. I find that homes assigned to higher climate ratings experience price increases and find suggestive evidence that higher-income families sort into these homes. These effects dissipate within a year as information salience declines. A subsequent ratings release generated muted capitalization, but higher-income households continued to react, consistent with unequal access to information.
abstract_zh: 本文研究公开的学校社会氛围信息如何被资本化至住房市场，并影响家庭分类。利用芝加哥首次发布学校氛围评级作为准外生信息冲击，我将边界断点设计与事件研究法和双重差分分析相结合。研究发现，被分配到较高氛围评级的房屋价格出现上涨，并发现高收入家庭倾向于选择这些房屋的初步证据。随着信息显著性的下降，这些效应在一年内消散。后续评级发布产生的资本化效应减弱，但高收入家庭仍持续反应，这与信息获取不平等的情况一致。

title: The Double-Edged Sword of Facilitated Giving: Field Evidence on Sales and Donations
title_zh: 促进捐赠的双刃剑：关于销售与捐赠的实地证据
title_primary: 促进捐赠的双刃剑：关于销售与捐赠的实地证据
title_secondary: The Double-Edged Sword of Facilitated Giving: Field Evidence on Sales and Donations
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Facilitated giving, a common yet under-researched form of cause-related marketing (CRM), involves companies collecting donations from customers to support charitable causes. This study examines the impact of facilitated giving on revenue from ticket sales at an opera house through two large-scale field experiments involving over 50,000 customers. The charitable initiative supported a social youth project aimed at enhancing cultural education and social integration for individuals from disadvantaged households. We found that a particularly pervasive donation ask led to a significant short-term reduction in ticket purchases by non-donors. However, this adverse effect was short-lived and we did not find any effect of the program on total revenue from tickets and donations, neither in the short run nor in the long run.
abstract_zh: 便利捐赠，作为一种常见但研究不足的公益关联营销形式，涉及企业收集顾客捐款以支持慈善事业。本研究通过两项涉及超过50,000名顾客的大规模现场实验，考察了便利捐赠对歌剧院门票销售收入的影响。所支持的慈善项目旨在为来自弱势家庭的人群提升文化教育和社会融入。我们发现，一种尤为普遍的捐款请求导致非捐赠者在短期内显著减少了门票购买。然而，这一不利影响是短暂的，且我们未发现该计划对门票及捐款总收入有任何影响，无论是在短期还是长期内。

title: TFPR: Dispersion and Cyclicality
title_zh: TFPR：离散性与周期性
title_primary: TFPR：离散性与周期性
title_secondary: TFPR: Dispersion and Cyclicality
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the dispersion and cyclicality of TFPR. Recent business cycle models assume countercyclical dispersion in TFPQ based on evidence of countercyclical dispersion in TFPR, though TFPR reflects endogenous prices. An overlapping generations model with monopolistic competition and state-dependent pricing is constructed to match three key data patterns: (i) countercyclical dispersion of TFPR, (ii) countercyclical dispersion of price changes, and (iii) countercyclical frequency of price adjustment. These patterns are matched either if shocks to the dispersion of TFPQ are negatively correlated with the mean of TFPQ, or if the monetary authority responds to them by “leaning against the wind.” (JEL D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52)
abstract_zh: 本文研究TFPR的离散性与周期性。近期商业周期模型基于TFPR反周期离散的证据假设TFPQ存在反周期离散，但TFPR反映的是内生价格。本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争和状态依存定价的代际交叠模型，以匹配三个关键数据特征：（i）TFPR的反周期离散性，（ii）价格变动的反周期离散性，以及（iii）价格调整频率的反周期性。这些特征得以匹配的条件是：要么TFPQ离散性的冲击与TFPQ均值呈负相关，要么货币当局通过“逆风干预”对此类冲击做出响应。（JEL分类号：D24, E23, E24, E32, E51, E52）

title: Risk shifting of Chinese multinational enterprises
title_zh: 中国跨国企业的风险转移
title_primary: 中国跨国企业的风险转移
title_secondary: Risk shifting of Chinese multinational enterprises
authors: Xiangjun Ma, W. Tian, Miaojie Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The literature on the profit-shifting activities and strategies of multinational enterprises (MNEs) has focused predominantly on developed economies. The experience of developing countries may differ, however, because they often employ preferential tax regimes which could substantially alter MNEs’ profit-shifting incentives. This paper studies MNEs of China, the largest developing country, and examines an implicit profit-shifting strategy, risk shifting, while explicitly incorporating China’s preferential tax policies into the empirical analysis. As a common practice in transfer pricing planning, MNEs shift profits to lower-tax jurisdictions by reallocating the operating risk embedded in intra-firm transactions. We find that when the tax rate differential between China and a foreign country increases by 10%, the risk remaining in the Chinese parent firms declines by 10% from the mean value. In addition, risk shifting into China is more pronounced than risk shifting out of China, which highlights the important role of preferential tax policies of China. The results are robust to alternative risk proxies including strategic risk and to alternative approaches to risk measurement. In particular, the estimated effects are stronger among firms with higher levels of intangible assets, inventory, or accounts receivable, where R&D risk, market risk, inventory risk, and credit risk are more likely to be salient.
abstract_zh: 关于跨国企业利润转移活动与策略的研究文献主要聚焦于发达经济体。然而，发展中国家的经验可能有所不同，因为它们常采用优惠税制，这可能会显著改变跨国企业的利润转移动机。本文以最大发展中国家中国的跨国企业为研究对象，在实证分析中明确纳入中国优惠税收政策，考察一种隐性利润转移策略——风险转移。作为转让定价规划中的常见做法，跨国企业通过重新分配公司内部交易中的经营风险，将利润转移至低税率管辖区。研究发现，当中国与外国之间的税率差异每增加10%，中国母公司留存的风险较均值下降10%。此外，风险向中国转移的效应强于风险从中国转出的效应，这凸显了中国优惠税收政策的重要作用。该结果在使用战略风险等替代风险指标及不同风险测量方法时依然稳健。特别地，在无形资产、存货或应收账款水平较高的企业中，研发风险、市场风险、存货风险及信用风险更易凸显，其估计效应更为显著。

title: Axiomatic analysis of depreciation problems
title_zh: 折旧问题的公理化分析
title_primary: 折旧问题的公理化分析
title_secondary: Axiomatic analysis of depreciation problems
official: 来源期次 2026-05-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper analyzes axiomatically what is known as “Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP),” focusing on depreciation. It is widely accepted that a depreciation method should be rational and systematic. There are many possible depreciation methods; however, only a few are used in practice, such as the straight-line method, the declining-balance method, the sum-of-the-years’ digits method, and the fair value measurement. We investigate through the axiomatic approach in what sense these depreciation methods can be considered rational and systematic. We provide a practical interpretation for each axiom examined in this paper and relate the axioms to accounting principles. Interestingly, it turns out that the straight-line method satisfies all but one of the axioms considered in the paper. Since the players are not humans in the model studied in the paper, it is not so clear whether the axiom of core selection is desirable or not in this context. Our analysis provides a positive answer to this question. Specifically, we show that core selection is a direct consequence of three compelling axioms: population monotonicity, the final year reasonableness, and conservatism.
abstract_zh: 本文以公理化方法分析了所谓的“公认会计原则”（GAAP），重点关注折旧问题。普遍认为，折旧方法应当合理且系统化。存在多种可能的折旧方法；然而，实践中仅使用少数几种，如直线法、余额递减法、年数总和法以及公允价值计量。我们通过公理化方法探究这些折旧方法在何种意义上可被视为合理且系统化。本文为所考察的每项公理提供了实际解释，并将这些公理与会计原则相联系。有趣的是，结果表明直线法满足本文考虑的所有公理，仅有一项除外。由于所研究模型中的参与者并非人类，核心选择公理在此情境下是否可取尚不明确。我们的分析对此问题给出了肯定答案。具体而言，我们证明核心选择是三个有力公理的直接结果：总体单调性、末年合理性以及稳健性。

title: Debasements and Small Coins: An Untold Story of Commodity Money
title_zh: 铸币贬损与小额硬币：商品货币的一段未述往事
title_primary: 铸币贬损与小额硬币：商品货币的一段未述往事
title_secondary: Debasements and Small Coins: An Untold Story of Commodity Money
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper draws quantitative implications for certain historical coinage issues by adapting a fiat‐money multiple‐denomination model. The model is parameterized to match some key monetary characteristics of late medieval England. A small coin has a more prominent role than mere small change; thus, a shortage of small coins is very costly for poor people, and when commerce advances, it is very costly for all people. A debasement may effectively supply substitutes for small coins in shortage. But debasements cannot be an ultimate solution because the precious metals used to produce coins are practically indivisible.
abstract_zh: 本文通过调整一种法定货币多面额模型，对特定历史时期的铸币问题进行了量化分析。该模型参数设定以匹配中世纪晚期英格兰的若干关键货币特征。小面额硬币的作用远不止于小额找零；因此，小面额硬币短缺对穷人而言代价高昂，而当商业发展时，对所有人群均会造成巨大损失。货币贬值可有效提供短缺小面额硬币的替代品。然而，由于用于铸造硬币的贵金属实际上不可分割，货币贬值并不能成为根本解决方案。

title: Optimal Labour Income Taxation: A Flexible Moral Hazard Approach
title_zh: 最优劳动收入税：一种灵活的道德风险方法
title_primary: 最优劳动收入税：一种灵活的道德风险方法
title_secondary: Optimal Labour Income Taxation: A Flexible Moral Hazard Approach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article reconsiders the question of optimal labour income taxes for the very rich in the context of a flexible moral hazard model. In this setting, risk is not exogenous. Rather, each agent can affect the probabilities of all possible income outcomes by allocating a fixed time endowment across a variety of distinct tasks. I prove that the optimal income tax rates on high-end earners and the optimal Pareto tail index of the pre-tax labour income distribution are both endogenously determined by agent preferences. In particular, a society with less risk-averse agents will find it optimal to impose a lower tax rate on the rich, even though its members’ choices give rise to a smaller Pareto right tail index. In contrast, this kind of negative co-movement between inequality and optimal tax rates is a suboptimal response in the classical Mirrlees (1971)–Diamond (1998)–Saez (2001) setup to changes in the exogenous distribution of skills.
abstract_zh: 本文在灵活的道德风险模型框架下重新审视了针对极高收入者的最优劳动所得税问题。在此设定中，风险并非外生变量。相反，每个行为人可通过将固定时间禀赋分配至多种不同任务，影响所有可能收入结果的发生概率。本文证明，高收入者的最优所得税率与税前劳动收入分布的最优帕累托尾部指数均由行为人偏好内生决定。具体而言，在行为人风险厌恶程度较低的社会中，即使其成员的选择导致更小的帕累托右尾指数，最优政策仍倾向于对富人征收更低的税率。与之形成对比的是，在经典的Mirrlees（1971）–Diamond（1998）–Saez（2001）框架下，这种不平等程度与最优税率之间的负向联动关系，实为对外生技能分布变化的次优反应。

title: Chasing the perfida Albione: Anglo‐Italian productivity gap in the late 1930s
title_zh: 追逐背信弃义的阿尔比恩：20世纪30年代末英意生产率差距
title_primary: 追逐背信弃义的阿尔比恩：20世纪30年代末英意生产率差距
title_secondary: Chasing the perfida Albione: Anglo‐Italian productivity gap in the late 1930s
official: 官方在线 2025-11-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents new estimates of Anglo‐Italian labour productivity levels in manufacturing in the late 1930s, derived using the standard single‐deflation approach. The findings confirm a substantial productivity gap between Italy and the United Kingdom at the aggregate level, alongside pronounced intersectoral heterogeneity. Italy appears relatively competitive in textiles and, to a lesser extent, in iron and steel and in chemicals. Preliminary estimates using the more advanced double‐deflation methodology, as well as tentative measures of productivity per hour worked, suggest that single‐deflation figures may represent a lower‐bound estimate. Nevertheless, the productivity gap remains large when benchmarked against other industrialized economies, lending support to a more pessimistic interpretation of the Fascist period in terms of labour productivity performance.
abstract_zh: 本文基于标准单一缩减方法，对20世纪30年代末期英意两国制造业劳动生产率水平进行了新的估算。研究结果证实，在总体层面上，意大利与英国之间存在显著的生产率差距，同时伴随着明显的部门间异质性。意大利在纺织业方面相对具有竞争力，在钢铁和化工行业则竞争力稍弱。采用更先进的双重缩减方法进行的初步估算，以及每小时工作生产率的尝试性测量，均表明单一缩减数据可能构成一个下限估计。尽管如此，与其他工业化经济体相比，生产率差距依然巨大，这支持了对法西斯时期劳动生产率表现更为悲观的解读。

title: Environmental regulation, firm adaptation, and industrial land prices: evidence from China’s clean air policies
title_zh: 环境规制、企业适应与工业用地价格：来自中国清洁空气政策的证据
title_primary: 环境规制、企业适应与工业用地价格：来自中国清洁空气政策的证据
title_secondary: Environmental regulation, firm adaptation, and industrial land prices: evidence from China’s clean air policies
authors: Linzi Zheng Yongjie Zheng Qingsong He Jinying Xu a College of Public Administration, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, Chinab Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, UK
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Environmental regulations are reshaping industrial land markets, yet their effects on firm behaviour and land demand remain underexplored. This study investigates how China’s clean air policies impact industrial land prices, emphasizing firm-level adaptation strategies. Using a difference-in-differences approach on 229 cities, we find that these policies significantly increase land prices, with larger cities experiencing the strongest gains, while manufacturing-heavy and pollution-intensive cities see weaker growth. Firms respond by adopting green initiatives and clustering in high-tech hubs, fuelling land demand, whereas polluting firms reduce land acquisitions. The relationship between regulatory stringency and land prices follows a weak U-shaped curve, indicating that moderate regulation fosters growth, but excessive stringency may dampen market activity. These findings highlight a fundamental shift in local land allocation strategies, where environmental priorities increasingly shape urban-industrial development. This research offers critical insights for policymakers navigating the trade-offs between sustainability and economic competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 环境规制正在重塑工业用地市场，但其对企业行为及土地需求的影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究考察中国清洁空气政策如何影响工业用地价格，重点关注企业层面的适应策略。基于对229个城市采用双重差分法，我们发现这些政策显著推高了土地价格，其中大城市涨幅最为明显，而制造业密集及污染密集型城市的增长则相对较弱。企业通过采取绿色举措并集聚于高科技中心作为应对，从而推升了土地需求，而污染型企业则减少了土地购置。规制强度与土地价格之间的关系呈现弱U型曲线，表明适度规制促进增长，但过度严格可能抑制市场活力。这些发现揭示了地方土地配置策略的根本性转变，环境优先事项日益塑造城市工业发展格局。本研究为政策制定者在可持续性与经济竞争力之间权衡取舍提供了重要洞见。
